title: Adaptive Temporal Mixture of Experts for Predicting Stiffness Metrics From the Ocular Response Analyzer and Identifying Keratoconus.
summary: AT-MoE uses LSTM experts with dynamic gating to predict Corvis stiffness from ORA waveforms/pressure-applanation data and classifies keratoconus. Development had 961 eyes/502 people with subject-separated 80/20 split; independent prospective validation improved AUROC from .9406 baseline LSTM to .9512. Limited validation and no Corvis stiffness ground truth in validation narrow interpretation. Development/test predictions improved versus LSTM and independent keratoconus discrimination AUROC reached .9512; no claim of clinical utility. Published in American Journal of Ophthalmology.
